posts.title: Gamma Dog firmware 6.2
posts.description: Many improvements and features in the audio response system. Ultra-fast boot mode was also added that essentially allows the user to quickly jump into the menu system at any point. New Frequency Glide feature changes the tone smoothly as the count rate increases instead of stepping through. Low Sensitivity mode is added for dealing with active specimens - the Pulse Height Threshold level is double
